title: Nine Parts Summer
subtitle: 男孩与少年 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 男孩与少年（生活与学习·家庭与成长）
meta: 主题语境：男孩与少年（生活与学习·家庭与成长）　|　核心词汇：boy　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 boy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1951 my mother was sent to teach ① a boy she could not reach, and she said the reaching was the whole of the lesson. The ② boy, meaning the child and not the pupil, was nine years old and was walked home by whoever came last; a boy, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how much has been taken out of him.

Every ③ boy in that class had the same ink, and the ④ boy at the back, meaning the one the master kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever taught properly. A boy, my grandmother said, is nine parts noise and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the noise is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ boy was the whole of the summer, meaning the season he filled and not the child. The ⑥ boy, meaning the summer and not any of that, is the only thing in a house that everybody waits for and nobody questions; a boy, he said, is either someone you teach or the only word that means both a child and a summer. She said the summer is the part they remember.

By 1966 the ⑦ boy had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the ink. The ⑧ boy of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine years of noise and eleven years of reaching; a boy, she said, is either the one at the back or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ boy I remember is the one at the back, which was photographed in 1971 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ boy, my grandmother said in 1975, is the only thing that improves by being trusted; every boy, she said, is a summer that has agreed to look like a child. She said the summer was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 男孩（指那个孩子本身，与学生身份相对）
C. 固定搭配：teach a boy 教一个男孩
D. n. 男孩（指班上每一个）
E. n. 男孩（指后面那一个）
F. n. 男孩（抽象：他所填满的那个夏天）
G. n. 那个夏天（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a boy she could not reach
The boy, meaning the child and not the pupil
boy was the whole of the summer
the boy had become a photograph in a report
The boy of the whole thing
A boy, my grandmother said in 1975

answers.why: teach a boy 意为“教一个男孩”，1951 年母亲被派去教一个她够不着的男孩。
boy 意为“男孩”，指那个孩子本身而不是学生身份，九岁，由最后走的人送回家。
boy 指班上每一个男孩，每一个人手上都是同样的墨水。
boy 指后面那一个（老师留的那一个），是唯一有人认真教过的。
boy 意为“男孩”，抽象指他所填满的那个夏天，父亲说 boy 就是那个夏天的全部。
boy 为抽象用法，指那个夏天本身，是屋子里人人都等、却没人质疑的东西。
boy 意为“男孩、少年”，到 1966 年这个 boy 成了报告里的一张照片。
boy 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的喧闹和十一年的靠近。
boy 意为“男孩”，我记得的是后面那一个，1971 年被拍下来，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
boy 为抽象总称，祖母说男孩是唯一会因为被信任而变好的。
